_comment: Trigger phrases per CLAUDE.md section, keyed by the heading EXACTLY as it appears in the
file (arrow, backticks and parenthetical date included). Values are regexes matched
A null value means no phrase is a fair proxy for the rule: it fires on every session,
silently, so counting phrases would libel it. Null and absent both report as unmeasured
(an em dash), never as 0 — only a section with a real phrase list can be said to have
never fired. Re-check the keys against `grep -n -E '^#{2,3} ' CLAUDE.md` when a heading
is renamed; a stale key measures nothing and its section silently goes unmeasured.
